name: BIMB
recent: Bank Islam 公布截至2026年9月30日季度的业绩，并宣布派发每股8.24仙的中期股息。同期，EPF 在10月至11月间多次申报其作为大股东的持股变动。RAM Ratings 重申该行的 AA3/Stable/P1 评级。
notable: 宣布截至2026年12月31日财年的中期单层股息每股8.24仙。
RAM Ratings 重申 Bank Islam 的 AA3/Stable/P1 评级。
EPF 在10月至11月间多次申报其作为大股东的持股变动。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为 MYR 718.77 million，环比增长15.7%，同比增长9.9%；净利为 MYR 139.12 million，环比增长20.9%，同比增长9.8%；净利率为19.4%，高于上一季度的18.5%。

recent_en: Bank Islam released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 and declared an interim dividend of 8.24 sen per share. Meanwhile, EPF made multiple substantial shareholder filings between October and November. RAM Ratings reaffirmed the bank's AA3/Stable/P1 ratings.
notable_en: Declared an interim single-tier dividend of 8.24 sen per share for the financial year ending 31 December 2026.
RAM Ratings reaffirmed Bank Islam's AA3/Stable/P1 ratings.
EPF made multiple substantial shareholder filings between October and November.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 718.77 million, up 15.7% QoQ and 9.9% YoY; net income was MYR 139.12 million, up 20.9% QoQ and 9.8% YoY; net margin was 19.4%, up from 18.5% in the previous quarter.
